sources.title: Stanley Druckenmiller: "The greatest investors make large concentrated bets where they have a lot of conviction"
sources.quote_checked: The greatest investors make large concentrated bets where they have a lot of conviction | I've never used the stop loss. Not once. It's the dumbest concept I've ever heard. | Your ego is not what this is about.

sources.title: Stanley Druckenmiller says he couldn't have been more wrong this year
sources.quote_checked: I couldn't have been more wrong | pivoted before it mattered

sources.quote_checked: First of all, the no down years is true, but a lot of it is luck. I've been deep in the hole three or four years.
